note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Fix seven verified settlement and integrity bugs
purpose: Seven bugs in settlement, queue and preservation handling were verified. Each can cause a duplicate session, a wrong queue, a stuck rejection, a garbled plan or a wrong record. This Plan fixes each one in its own pull request.
serves: The Project outcome of Arcadia's governed work staying trustworthy when it runs unattended.
done_when: Each of the seven fixes is merged to main in its own pull request, with its regression test and a passing rehearsal.

actions.title: Keep a claim when a passed receipt cannot be read
actions.why: A garbled receipt currently releases the claim, which can start a duplicate session for a finished candidate.
actions.done_when: A passed attempt with a malformed receipt keeps its claim, and a well-formed superseded attempt still releases it, each with a regression test.

actions.title: Let a superseded decision request be rejected
actions.why: Six superseded decision rejections are stuck, and a similar identifier could match the wrong request.
actions.done_when: A superseded decision request can be rejected, and an identifier that is a prefix of another matches only its own request.

actions.title: Amend actions with exact text and identifiers
actions.why: An amendment can show old and new instructions joined together, and special characters can garble a plan.
actions.done_when: An amended instruction equals the requested text exactly, and text containing special characters is written literally by every writer.

actions.title: Keep queue positions for projects that are temporarily hidden
actions.why: A temporary block on one project can erase another project's order and stop every ordering change.
actions.done_when: Arranging the queue while one project is temporarily blocked leaves that project's positions intact, and retired items are still removed.

actions.title: Refuse completion proofs that hide a deletion
actions.why: A rename can make a deleted governed record look as if it was never removed.
actions.done_when: A commit that renames a governed record into the asks folder is refused, and a forced timeout leaves no leftover scratch folder.

actions.title: Stop two decisions taking the same number
actions.why: Parallel sessions can allocate the same Decision number, so a citation may point to the wrong record.
actions.done_when: New Decision numbers are allocated from the main branch as well as local files, and a new duplicate number fails the lint check.

actions.title: Keep text values as text in saved records
actions.why: A title such as true or a bracketed phrase can silently turn into a different type, which unattended agents would not notice.
actions.done_when: Values such as true, null, 123 and bracketed text are saved and read back unchanged as text, and ordinary text renders as before.
